name: Malki-Shua
title: Saul's son
summary: Malki-Shua was one of King Saul's sons. He fell together with his father and his brothers Jonathan and Abinadab in the battle against the Philistines on Mount Gilboa. He is primarily known from the genealogies and the account of Saul's downfall.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Saul's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Malki-Shua is listed as one of Saul's sons in the genealogy in 1 Samuel.

keyEvents.title: The battle on Mount Gilboa
keyEvents.description: Malki-Shua fell together with his father Saul and his brothers Jonathan and Abinadab in the catastrophic battle against the Philistines on Mount Gilboa.

keyEvents.title: David's Lament over Saul and His Sons
keyEvents.description: After the death of Saul and his sons, David sang a lament over them, mourning the loss of Israel's heroes.

keyEvents.title: The Philistines' Desecration of the Dead
keyEvents.description: The Philistines found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa, cut off Saul's head, and took his weapons as spoils of war.

keyEvents.title: Men from Jabesh-Gilead Retrieve the Bodies
keyEvents.description: Brave men from Jabesh in Gilead retrieved the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth-shan and gave them a dignified burial.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Malki-Shua is also mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles, confirming his place in Saul's family and his death in battle.
